title: Feature: Fuzzy Rename/Move Detection via Levenshtein Distance (ADR-011)

done: src/core/domain/diff-algorithm.ts — serialize(), leafName(), parentPath(), isRelated() helpers already present
src/core/domain/flatten.ts — leafName() exported, used by diff-algorithm

steps.name: Create levenshtein.ts pure functions
steps.description: Create src/core/domain/levenshtein.ts with four pure functions: levenshtein(a,b), pathSimilarity(oldPath,newPath), valueSimilarity(a,b), matchScore(oldPath,newPath,oldVal,newVal). Export FUZZY_THRESHOLD=0.65 constant. No imports outside domain/. Use Wagner-Fischer DP for levenshtein. pathSimilarity compares leaf names only (use existing leafName() — import from flatten.js). valueSimilarity: identical→1.0, both string→levenshtein-based, both number→relative distance (1-|a-b|/max(|a|,|b|)), both object→Jaccard on keys, different types→0.0. matchScore = 0.6*pathSimilarity + 0.4*valueSimilarity.
steps.done_condition: File compiles with tsc --noEmit; levenshtein('rename','rename')===0; levenshtein('abc','xyz')===3; pathSimilarity('','')===1; valueSimilarity('a',1)===0; matchScore produces 0.6*path+0.4*value

steps.name: Integrate fuzzy fallback in diff-algorithm
steps.description: Update src/core/domain/diff-algorithm.ts to integrate fuzzy fallback in diffFlatMaps(). When exact-match rename lookup (fbOnlyByValue index) finds no match, scan fb-only keys using matchScore() and FUZZY_THRESHOLD from levenshtein.ts. Track bestMatch (highest score above threshold) — do NOT return first-match. Set confidence=Math.round(bestMatch.score*100)/100 on the pushed DiffResult. Similarly add fuzzy fallback in the move-detection block: when exact leaf+value index misses, scan fb-only keys for same-leaf fuzzy value match above threshold. Import levenshtein.ts via './levenshtein.js'.
steps.done_condition: tsc --noEmit passes; existing computeDiff behavior unchanged for exact matches (S01); account_balance→balance with value change produces 'renamed' not 'removed'+'added' (S02); below-threshold pair produces 'removed'+'added' (S05); best-match wins over first-match (S04)

steps.name: Write unit tests for levenshtein and fuzzy rename
steps.description: Write unit tests in src/core/domain/levenshtein.test.ts covering all 10 specs: levenshtein edge cases (identical, disjoint, empty), pathSimilarity zero-guard, valueSimilarity type-mismatch returns 0, matchScore weighting, and integration scenarios calling computeDiff with rename+value-change pairs. Use Bun's built-in test runner (import { test, expect } from 'bun:test'). Do not import from outside src/core/domain/.
steps.done_condition: bun test src/core/domain/levenshtein.test.ts passes all cases; coverage includes all 4 exported functions and the fuzzy-rename integration path in computeDiff

mergeOrder: All three are sequential — each builds on the previous

riskRegister.risk: Fuzzy matching increases false-positive renames (unrelated fields incorrectly paired)
riskRegister.mitigation: Threshold 0.65 was validated against real API pairs in ADR-011. Tests include S05 (below-threshold pair) to catch regression. Confidence field in UI will expose match quality.

riskRegister.risk: Performance regression — fuzzy scan is O(n*m * k) vs O(1) index lookup
riskRegister.mitigation: Fuzzy path only runs when exact-match index misses. API field names are 5-30 chars; levenshtein is negligible vs HTTP latency. Add note if O(n^2) behavior appears on very large schemas (>1000 keys).

riskRegister.risk: Existing tests that assert 'removed'+'added' for rename+value-change pairs may now fail
riskRegister.mitigation: No existing test suite found — but run hex analyze and bun test after step-2 to catch regressions before step-3.

riskRegister.risk: Circular import if levenshtein.ts imports from diff-algorithm.ts
riskRegister.mitigation: levenshtein.ts must ONLY import from flatten.ts (for leafName). diff-algorithm.ts imports levenshtein.ts — one-way dependency. ADR-011 rule in adr-rules.toml enforces levenshtein stays in domain.

successCriteria: hex analyze reports 0 boundary violations after all steps merged
All 10 behavioral specs pass as bun tests
completion_evidence: ADR-011 accepted; levenshtein.ts + levenshtein.test.ts + diff-algorithm.ts integration shipped. Reconciled from planned → done — code long-shipped, JSON status never flipped.
